max_file_size_mb.title: Maximum File Size (MB)
max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum upload size for files in the media manager.

approved_extensions.title: Approved File Extensions
approved_extensions.default: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, svg, pdf, mp4, webm, mp3, wav, zip
approved_extensions.description: Comma-separated list of allowed extensions without dots. Use * to allow all file types.

image_styles.title: Image Styles
image_styles.description: Named derivatives generated on image upload. Key thumbnail maps to legacy _thumb files. Mode fit only; width 1–4096; height 0 = proportional. Never upscales.

key.title: Key
key.description: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore. thumbnail writes _thumb.

height.title: Max Height
height.description: 0 keeps aspect ratio from width only.
